corrections.proposed: Remove from registers. Keep as source codes only: BLL-50815 (coordinates GFC provided) and gfc-006 (older GFC list).
corrections.why: The list describes BLL-nnn as GFC-supplied coordinates for 118 towers and gfc-nnn as an older GFC list of 203 towers. It does not describe either code as a register entry, and the National Historic Lookout Register state list does not include Lincolnton.

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us compiled list places this tower. Two WebSearches and the local caches found no Lincoln County lookout record, no GFC record and no removal notice. The vanishinggeorgia.com page titled Lincolnton Fire Department is a fire station building, not a lookout; it is not used. The name lincolnton is the compiler's label (entry 240 is at or above 73), not a documented name; do not treat it as the historic name. The brief's registers values are not supported by the list (see corrections). The record's elevation_m (155.4) assumes the 510 is feet; the page gives no unit. Story is about 146 words, close to the guide's figure for thin sources, and no other source describes the tower. Editor may want to hold it. No photos. Next checks: GFC tower records by county, Lincoln County Historical Society, Lincoln Journal or Lincolnton newspaper archives.
